title: Signal Fusion: Buyer Journey Mapping for Model-Fallback Economics
creator: Asha Patel
description: Synthesize competitive signals and field research to produce a buyer-journey map that shows decision points where customers choose (1) hosted vs dedicated vs private deployments and (2) model variants/fallbacks. This ticket delivers the artifact and a recommended set of telemetry hooks the Console and Sales teams can use to detect movement along the journey and trigger product or commercial interventions.
background: We maintain a large backlog of model signals (availability, latency, price, quantization readiness). Sales and Solutions Engineering repeatedly ask for a clear, actionable map of how those signals affect procurement decisions. Current docs are fragmented (per-model cheat sheets, ad-hoc field notes). We need a single narrative and measurable checkpoints that translate model-landscape changes into customer-level risk and opportunity.
goals: Produce a buyer-journey map with 6 canonical decision nodes (trial -> scale -> procurement)
Identify top 10 signals that most frequently cause customers to change model choices or deployment modes
Define 5 telemetry hooks (Console events + Sales CRM flags) to detect early-stage risk of model substitution
Recommend 3 commercial or product interventions (pricing, reserved capacity nudges, automated fallback policies) mapped to journey nodes
success_metrics: Stakeholder sign-off: Product, Sales, Solutions Eng, 80% agreement on map
Pilot telemetry implemented for at least 2 hooks within 4 weeks of delivery
Reduction in manual escalation tickets about model outages by 25% in pilot accounts
Actionable playbook accepted by two enterprise AE teams
scope: Competitive signal analysis (public outages, pricing changes, quant releases) for the 6 most-used open models
Qualitative interviews with 8 customers across SMB and mid-market segments
Mapping of Console dashboards and existing webhooks to proposed telemetry hooks
Recommendation of short-term product levers (alerts, canary fallback policies, pricing nudges)
out_of_scope: Implementation of new Console UI components (will be filed as separate ENG tickets)
Deep engineering work to modify serving runtime kernels
tasks: Assemble competitive signal dataset: availability, median latency, avg token price (last 90 days)
Run 8 customer interviews and synthesize decision triggers
Draft buyer-journey map and iterate with Sales and Solutions Eng
Workshop with Console PM and Observability to define telemetry hooks
Write short playbook mapping triggers -> recommended interventions
Present artifact to GTM leadership and collect acceptance feedback
